INTERNAL COMPLAINT — Priya Natarajan to Hartwell HR
Date: June 12, 2023
Submitted via: HR ethics portal, Ref. ETH-2023-0612-44

To: Renee Patel, Chief People Officer
From: Priya Natarajan, Director of Analytics

Renee,

I want to formally document concerns I have about my reporting relationship with Brendan Coulter since the January reorganization.

Specific incidents:
1. In a 1:1 on 02/15/2023, Brendan said to me, "You and I think differently — generationally. I think we need to find a way to bridge that or it's going to be a problem." When I asked what he meant, he changed the subject.
2. In our 03/08 team meeting, he said, "Maybe it's time to bring in someone more current to lead this." I was the only person in the room responsible for "leading this."
3. On 05/12, without consulting me, he reassigned all three of my direct reports to other managers, effectively removing my management responsibility. When I asked for the business rationale, he said, "I'm restructuring how we work — you'll see."
4. I have heard from two team members that in meetings I was not in, Brendan has referred to wanting to "refresh" the team or "bring in fresh thinking."

I am 54 years old. I am the only person of South Asian descent in my org at the Director level or above. I have received "Exceeds Expectations" in every review for the eight years I have been at Hartwell. I have given no indication of any performance issue.

I am asking that HR document these concerns and that someone in your office speak with Brendan about appropriate language and decision-making processes.

Thank you,
Priya Natarajan

[HR response, 06/19/2023: "We've noted your concerns and will discuss with Brendan informally. Please let us know if anything else arises." No further documentation in HR file regarding this complaint.]
